name: @certinia/apex-log-mcp

tools.name: apexlog_list_slow_operations
tools.description: Rank what an Apex debug log spent its time on by self-execution time, or on the heap it retains - code units, methods, queries, searches, DML, flows and workflows in one table, each row with its calls, durations, database counts and rows, so the caller can see what to optimize and why, beside the query optimizer's plan for the queries among them.

debugCategory.description: Rank only these debug log categories

type.description: Rank only these log event types, e.g. SOQL_EXECUTE_BEGIN, DML_BEGIN, METHOD_ENTRY

minSelfMs.description: Drop operations below this self time (default: 0), whichever sortBy is used

limit.description: Page size (default: 10); fewer if the page would be too large

offset.description: Ranked rows to skip (default: 0). Advance it by the rows you got, which can be fewer than limit.

groupBy.description: Fold repeats into one row; default name. callerNamespace attributes platform DML to the package that drove it. debugCategory folds a namespace's event types together and so states no type or name. none ranks each call on its own. A grouped durationTotalMs is what the transaction takes back if the group never runs - never sum it across rows.

sortBy.description: Default durationSelfMs. heapSelfNetBytes adds that column.

tools.name: apexlog_get_summary
tools.description: Get a high-level summary of an Apex debug log: how long the transaction ran, where the time went by debug log category and the level each was logged at, every governor limit it and each namespace consumed, whether the log is complete, and what ended the transaction if it failed. Best for a quick overview.

tools.name: apexlog_list_limit_risks
tools.description: List the governor limits an Apex log transaction has nearly consumed - CPU time, heap, SOQL and SOSL queries, DML statements, and the rows each returned or wrote - worst first, with how much of each was used

threshold.description: Report a limit once it is this percentage consumed (default: 80)

tools.name: apexlog_execute_anonymous
tools.description: Execute a snippet of anonymous Apex against an authenticated Salesforce org (via SF CLI). Saves the resulting debug log to a local file and returns a summary with the file path, which the analysis tools accept. Production orgs require per-call user confirmation or the --allow-production-orgs server flag.

apex.description: The anonymous Apex to be executed

targetOrg.description: Alias or username of the target Salesforce org. Uses the project default if not specified.

outputDir.description: Directory to save the debug log file. Defaults to .apex-log-mcp/ in the project root.

debugLevel.description: Trace flag log levels. "default" restores the defaults; a bare level sets every category to it; an object sets only the categories named and leaves the rest unchanged. Defaults: apexCode, apexProfiling, visualforce, workflow FINE; callout, system, validation DEBUG; database FINEST; nba, wave INFO.

instructions: Analysis tools take an absolute path to a .log file. Every duration is milliseconds, and every governor limit is a count except cpuTime in milliseconds and heapSize in bytes. Start with apexlog_get_summary, then go deeper with the other tools. Counts and limits are always reported, so a zero is a measured zero and not a missing value.
